title: Watercolor "A Shuckin' Good Time" 74 Wisteria Way
h1: Watercolor "A Shuckin' Good Time" 74 Wisteria Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- Located in the Crossings district of WaterColor- Access to community pools, nature trails, and dune lakes- Conveniently located near Publix & restaurants- Private pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $25 per day**- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- 4 adult bikes- Outdoor Fireplace- Sonos sound system- Professionally decorated- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Located in the Crossings District of WaterColor, 74 Wisteria Way is a beautiful 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom house that can accommodate up to 10 guests. It's conveniently located to restaurants, Publix, nature trails, and the neighborhood pools that are easily accessible with the home's 4 adult bikes or 6-seater Low-Speed Vehicle. It's also just a short ride away to the beautiful Gulf of Mexico. The entire home has a natural, coastal charm from a professional designer with wooden floors and graceful interiors that is signature to WaterColor's iconic style. The first floor of the home has an open kitchen and living area that opens up to the back patio. With sparkling white marble countertops and stainless-steel appliances, the room has a sleek and clean feel. There are premium Wolfe and Sub-Zero appliances, a wine refrigerator, and an ice maker as well. There is room for 10 at the breakfast bar and dining table to eat together. The spacious patio also has outdoor seating that overlooks the private pool and covered cabana, which has a flat-screen TV, ceiling fan, beverage refrigerator, gas fireplace and is surrounded by lush greenery. The home's pool has a tanning ledge with lounge chairs that are perfect for sunbathing! Also on this floor is a half-bathroom, large laundry room, butler's pantry, and primary guest suite with a king bed and private bathroom. The second floor has 3 bedrooms and an additional living area with a queen sleeper sofa. The primary bedroom on this floor has a king bed with a private bathroom. The second king bedroom has a shared bathroom. The final bedroom has a full-size murphy bed and an attached bathroom that is shared with the king bedroom. The home also notably has a Tesla charging station, which is special to have along 30A! Guests will love having a private pool to enjoy and sunbathe when you're not on the beach. The WaterColor Beach Club also has several food options, chair setups, and resort-style pools to entertain all ages. The award-winning community of WaterColor truly has all you need for the perfect beach vacation. Don't miss your chance to stay at 74 Wisteria Way!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 10):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Half Bathroom: Toilet OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Murphy Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Landing Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa- Half Bathroom: Toilet OnlyWeddings are not allowed at this home.Unfortunately, the Big Green Egg is not for guest use.
